caseStudies.title: Scaling a B2B SaaS Platform with AI-Driven Lead Scoring
caseStudies.summary: Innovate SaaS struggled with a lengthy sales cycle and low conversion rates. We implemented an AI-powered lead scoring model that prioritized high-intent prospects, resulting in a 133% increase in sales efficiency.

caseStudies.title: Boosting AOV by 40% Through Hyper-Personalization
caseStudies.summary: Luxe Retail Co. had a large product catalog but a generic user experience. By integrating a real-time personalization engine, we delivered tailored product recommendations that increased AOV by 40%.

caseStudies.title: Reducing Patient Onboarding Time by 70% with Automation
caseStudies.summary: HealthBridge Clinics was losing potential patients due to a cumbersome, paper-based onboarding process. We designed and deployed an automated workflow that digitized forms and reduced staff workload.
